material_defect.summary: The V6 micro-taker online target was labeled from the first REST observation available after t+h rather than the last locally observed book state at or before t+h.
material_defect.why_material: That creates a variable effective forecast horizon and can import price movement occurring after the requested horizon. The V6 research smoke also called this a markout probe while reporting only sample/labeled/open-position counts, not causal target timing or realized micro economics.
material_defect.prior_hf_context: The earlier V5 HF causal audit had already identified first-post-horizon targeting as invalid and required receive-time/as-of-horizon evaluation before interpreting short-horizon edge.

repair.target_clock: local observation time stored in each sample
repair.target_rule: last stored midpoint strictly after forecast origin and at or before origin+horizon

economic_interpretation.reason: Correcting label causality is necessary before using the V6 micro-taker smoke as economic evidence. Prior fixed-pressure and first-window causal taker evidence was nonpositive after executable-cost stress, so lowering taker admission thresholds is not justified by the current sample.
economic_interpretation.next_gate: Use the corrected exact-head V6 smoke plus independent forward windows to require positive executable micro utility after spread, fees and slippage, then add measured submit-latency/stale-book stress before any threshold relaxation or promotion.
